name: rea
description: Reverse Engineer Anything: local MCP server bridging AI agents to reverse-engineering analysis (native binaries via Ghidra/Hopper/IDA, Electron/JavaScript, Android APK/devices, firmware, EVM bytecode, HAR captures, crash dumps) and AgentEnv bundles built from live captures, plus the reverse-engineer-anything investigation skill. Skills and MCP from morluto/rea (MIT).

description_i18n.en: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything): local MCP server bridging agents to RE analysis of native binaries, Electron/JS apps, Android, firmware, EVM, crash dumps, and AgentEnv bundles from live captures, with the reverse-engineer-anything skill. Source: morluto/rea (MIT).
description_i18n.zh-CN: 【安全研究】REA（Reverse Engineer Anything）：本地 MCP 服务桥接逆向分析引擎（Ghidra/Hopper/IDA 原生二进制、Electron/JS、Android、固件、EVM 字节码、HAR 抓包、崩溃转储），并可从实时抓取构建 AgentEnv 环境包，附 reverse-engineer-anything 调查技能。源自 morluto/rea（MIT），仅用于合法授权的逆向研究。
